scripts.lint: node --check site/app.js && node --check site/brand.js && node --check site/logic.js && python3 -m compileall -q scripts tests
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.verify: npm run check:data && npm run check:brand && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run verify
